## Astronomical 0.2.58
### Added
- The `astronomical` command-line interface now ships inside the macOS app bundle. After installing or updating, the app installs and automatically repairs the `/usr/local/bin/astronomical` symlink on launch, so the CLI works in your terminal without any separate setup. You can also install or remove the link anytime from the menu bar popover.
### Fixed
- Chat streaming no longer drops trailing text deltas when a response finishes between stream polls. This fix also removes an intermittent failure in the conversation canvas test contracts.
### Notes
- Requires macOS 14.0 or later on Apple silicon. - Your existing settings, models, and state are preserved by this update. - This release is signed, notarized, and distributed as a disk image through the public download and the signed Sparkle update feed.
